messages:
anna_ml: heads-up — on the new int8 canary the funcall JSON parse failures spike when streaming is enabled. saw ~7% parse_fail vs ~1.2% with streaming off. reproducer attached.

sam_runtime: can you paste an example broken payload? do we think it's cutoff mid-token or mismatched braces from sampling noise?

anna_ml: example below — streaming cut right at a nested object boundary. note extra trailing '\\n' in stream; parser fails on strict schema.

anna_ml: ```\n{"action": "create_ticket", "params": {"title": "OOM on shard 3", "metadata": {"severity": "high", "owner": "infra-team"}}, "steps": ["capture logs", "restart replica"\n```\n
maria_qe: ugh. streaming boundary + sampling temp = messy. two orthogonal fixes: 1) repair pass that asks model to output only valid JSON given the prefix, 0-temp; 2) runtime-level sentinel + buffer so we only parse completed chunks.

jack_devex: repair-pass makes sense if it's cheap. can we run repair on a smaller, quantized model (rwd-small-int8) to save cost/latency? also want metrics: repair tokens, extra latency, success after repair.

sam_runtime: runtime note: kv-cache gets flushed across concurrent stream chunks for big batches; if the model reuses partial kvcache between stream fragments we may see context drift. lowering streaming chunk_size to 256 reduced failures in a quick smoke.

maria_qe: experiment matrix proposal:
- streaming: on/off
- chunk_size: 256 / 512 / 1024
- quant: int4 / int8 / fp16
- temp: 0.0 / 0.2 / 0.6
- repair_mode: none / inline_repair / async_repair

metrics:
- parse_success_rate (primary)
- repair_success_rate
- median_repair_tokens
- p95_end_to_end_latency

sam_runtime: also track "partial_json_prefix_len" and "last_chunk_boundary_token" so we can correlate chunk cuts with parse failures.

anna_ml: minimal repair prompt i used locally:

anna_ml: ```\nYou are a JSON validator/repair tool. Given a text prefix that may contain a partial JSON value, output a single valid JSON object that conforms to the schema. Do not add any explanation. Schema: {"action": string, "params": object, "steps": [string]}. Prefix:\n<<PREFIX>>\n```\n
anna_ml: example repair run (0-temp, small model):

anna_ml: broken -> ```{"action": "create_ticket", "params": {"title": "OOM on shard 3", "metadata": {"severity": "high", "owner": "infra-team"}}, "steps": ["capture logs", "restart replica"\n``` 
anna_ml: repaired -> ```{"action":"create_ticket","params":{"title":"OOM on shard 3","metadata":{"severity":"high","owner":"infra-team"}},"steps":["capture logs","restart replica"]}```

jack_devex: looks good. we should be careful about hallucinated fields during repair — enforce schema strictness and reject repairs that add unknown keys.

maria_qe: agree. repair service should run schema validation after repair and if mismatch, mark for manual QA and feed to the eval set.

sam_runtime: two runtime mitigations to try in parallel: 1) reduce streaming chunk size + enforce chunk boundary tokenization; 2) emit explicit end-of-json sentinel token from model via a constrained stop sequence when in funcall mode (if model supports). fallback to repair if sentinel missing.

anna_ml: cost/latency projection — if repair rate 7% and repair adds 12 tokens median on small model, cost delta negligible vs full model. main risk is tail latency; we can make repair async (ack fast, repair in background and retry) for nonblocking flows.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of rwd-new-int8 streaming fix started by @sam_runtime — roll id: roll-2026-03-20-13

jack_devex: timeline? can we get a first pass in 48h? I can wire a small CI job to compute parse_success_rate on canary data.

anna_ml: i'll run the 3x3 matrix (chunk_size x temp) on the canary set tonight and dump results to /tmp/stream-json-probe.csv. will include raw prefixes for failing cases.

maria_qe: i'll add repair-check to the eval harness and a regression alert (if parse_success_rate drops >1% vs baseline). will also add a label for "streaming_boundary".

sam_runtime: i'll add instrumentation for last_chunk_boundary_token and emit a histogram. also toggling chunk_size per request via runtime flag so we can A/B.

anna_ml: thanks. action items: anna -> run matrix & dump CSV; maria -> add repair-check to CI; sam -> runtime flags + histograms; jack -> CI job for parse_success_rate. :eyes:

jack_devex: :shipit:

maria_qe: thumbs up. will also collect ztests on repair false positives.

anna_ml: will post the CSV and a short notebook with analysis once done.
